code.useCode: Sign in with a code instead
code.requestHint: We send a code to your open dashboard sessions and, when email is set up, to your email address. It only works in this browser.
code.where: Find it in the banner of any dashboard you are signed in to, with {{cli}}, or in your email.

approval.waitingHint: Your password was right, but this browser is new. Open the dashboard where you are already signed in and approve the request, or run {{cli}} there.
approval.denied: The sign-in was denied from another session.
approval.expired: Nobody approved the sign-in in time. Sign in again.
approval.alternative: No other device at hand? Sign in with a code sent to your email instead.

requests.bannerTitle: Someone is signing in to your account
requests.warning: Only continue if you started this sign-in yourself.
requests.notRevealable: The code is no longer available here. Ask for a new one from the sign-in page.
requests.actionFailed: Could not update the sign-in request
requests.empty: No sign-in is waiting for you.

devices.title: Trusted browsers
devices.description: Browsers that can sign in with your password without asking another session for approval. Revoke one you no longer use.

settings.title: Sign in with a code
settings.description: Let people sign in with a one-time code instead of a password. Two-factor authentication is still required where it is on.
settings.adminsHint: Off by default: an admin code is worth full control of the instance.
settings.approvalOn: New-browser approval is on for password sign-in.
settings.approvalOff: New-browser approval is off on this control plane.
